title.zh: 复盘参与节奏与退出空间
title.en: Review participation pace and room to leave

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的想象参与方式，看看起点是否舒服、想看的部分是什么，以及何时可以离开。只看一处也可以算这次完整选择；若今天不想去，就保留不参加。这个记录关注愿意怎样参与，不用说话多少或停留多久评价勇气。
paragraphs.en: After the imagined way of joining above, check the starting point, what you want to see and when you could leave. Looking at one thing can be this occasion’s complete choice. Keep nonparticipation available if you do not want to go today. Review your preferred approach without using speech or time spent to grade courage.

title.zh: 分享一个由自己决定的参与方式
title.en: Share a self-chosen way to join

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“假设看一个可随时离开的小展示，你想从边上看、直接聊，还是换个时间？”可以不同步，不要求朋友陪伴或替谁突破所谓胆小。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “At an imaginary display you could leave freely, would you look from the edge, talk directly or choose another time?” Different paces need neither companionship nor a push to overcome supposed timidity.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享公开通用说明，也可以不分享。链接不带本次答案或计数，对方可以不回答；不用角色名替朋友下结论。
paragraphs.en: You may share the public general guide or keep it private. Its link carries no attempt answers or counts. The other person may decline; a character name need not become a judgement about a friend.

title.zh: 复盘说清的部分与仍未知的意思
title.en: Review what became clear and what remains unknown

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的物件描述，区分自己实际知道的细节、借用的名称和仍不确定的意思。若向别人确认，只记录对方说过的话，不补造结论。短句或保留未知都可以；这次练习不要求替大家解释，也不以对方是否赞同评价表达能力。
paragraphs.en: After the object description above, separate a detail you know, a name you used and meaning still uncertain. If you ask someone, record what they actually said without supplying a conclusion. A short sentence or an open question is enough. The exercise requires neither speaking for everyone nor agreement as a grade for expression.

title.zh: 分享一个可以换说法的问题
title.en: Share a question that allows another wording

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“假设一个小物件的名字不熟悉，你想先问用途、外形，还是等以后再了解？”可以暂不解释，不把多说或少说当聪明、乐观的证明。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If an imaginary small object had an unfamiliar name, would you ask about use, appearance or leave it for another time?” No immediate explanation is needed, and more or fewer words prove neither intelligence nor optimism.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享公开通用说明，也可以不分享。链接不带本次答案或计数，对方可以不回答；不用角色名替朋友下结论。
paragraphs.en: You may share the public general guide or keep it private. Its link carries no attempt answers or counts. The other person may decline; a character name need not become a judgement about a friend.

title.zh: 复盘意外变化与是否还想玩
title.en: Review the variation and whether it still appeals

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的纸上变化，记下哪处意外让自己有兴趣，以及想保留、展开还是收起。无用或没引起笑声也不使它失败；不想玩时可以停下。若涉及别人，先确认材料和参与意愿，不把角色的活泼当成不断逗乐或冒险的任务。
paragraphs.en: After the paper variation above, note what interested you and whether to keep, unfold or put it away. No use or laughter is required for it to count. Stop when it no longer appeals. Confirm materials and willingness when others are involved without turning fictional liveliness into a duty to entertain or take risks.

title.zh: 分享一个只用自己材料的玩法
title.en: Share play using your own material

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“假设自己的废纸折出一个没用途的形状，你想再添一笔、展开看看，还是到这里？”允许平常和安静的答案，不比赛谁更怪、更大胆。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If your own imaginary scrap paper made a shape without a use, would you add a mark, unfold it or stop here?” Ordinary, quiet answers need no contest in oddness or boldness.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享公开通用说明，也可以不分享。链接不带本次答案或计数，对方可以不回答；不用角色名替朋友下结论。
paragraphs.en: You may share the public general guide or keep it private. Its link carries no attempt answers or counts. The other person may decline; a character name need not become a judgement about a friend.

title.zh: 复盘愿望与对方的真实答复
title.en: Review the wish and the actual reply

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的愿望句，检查它是否让人知道具体想要什么，也给拒绝留下位置。若已表达，记录实际答复，而不是把沉默当同意。没有得到想要的东西，可以再商量或停止；角色名称既不指控动机，也不让任何请求自动获得满足。
paragraphs.en: After the wish sentence above, check whether it states what you want and leaves room for refusal. If you expressed it, note the actual reply rather than treating silence as agreement. Discuss or stop when the wish is not fulfilled. A character name neither accuses your motives nor makes a request automatically entitled to fulfilment.

title.zh: 分享一个可以有不同偏好的选择
title.en: Share a choice with different preferences

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“假设几张普通纪念卡里你喜欢蓝色那张，你想怎样说明，也给别人的偏好留位置？”只讨论请求，不用可爱程度或谁得到卡片评价结果。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If you preferred the blue card among imaginary keepsakes, how would you say so while leaving room for others’ preferences?” Discuss requests without cuteness or who receives the card grading the result.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享公开通用说明，也可以不分享。链接不带本次答案或计数，对方可以不回答；不用角色名替朋友下结论。
paragraphs.en: You may share the public general guide or keep it private. Its link carries no attempt answers or counts. The other person may decline; a character name need not become a judgement about a friend.

title.zh: 复盘这次喜欢的具体细节
title.en: Review the particular detail you enjoyed

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的颜色或光线，留下一项自己想多看一眼的细节即可，也可以不记录。不必判断它是否让自己平静，更不需要买东西或模仿人物习惯。今天没有喜欢的细节也可以；小舒适是可选体验，不是生活质量的成绩。
paragraphs.en: After the colour or light above, keep one detail you want another look at, or keep no record. You need neither judge whether it calmed you, buy anything nor imitate fictional habits. Finding no appealing detail today is available too. A small comfort is an optional experience rather than a quality-of-life score.

title.zh: 分享一个各自喜欢的细节
title.en: Share a detail each person enjoys

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“假设看同一张普通风景照片，你愿意多看哪一处，也可以不选？”可以各自不同，不用饮食、饮酒或放松效果证明像某个角色。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “In the same imaginary ordinary landscape photo, which part would you look at longer, or would you choose none?” Different answers require no food, drinking or relaxation outcome to prove resemblance.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享公开通用说明，也可以不分享。链接不带本次答案或计数，对方可以不回答；不用角色名替朋友下结论。
paragraphs.en: You may share the public general guide or keep it private. Its link carries no attempt answers or counts. The other person may decline; a character name need not become a judgement about a friend.

title.zh: 复盘经验的范围与适用条件
title.en: Review the scope and conditions of experience

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的两句经验说明，核对实际试了什么、没试什么，以及哪些条件可能不同。别人不采用不等于不尊重自己；没有合适经验也可以直接说不知道。若需要专业判断，另找相应事实和资格，不把角色排名换算成现实指导权。
paragraphs.en: After the two-sentence experience note above, check what you tried, what you did not and which conditions might differ. Non-adoption need not mean disrespect, and you may have no suitable experience to offer. Seek relevant evidence and qualifications for professional judgements rather than converting fictional rank into real authority.

title.zh: 分享一项有边界的经验

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“假设你只试过让一小张纸暂时立住，怎样说明它未承重、也未试其他材料？”让对方决定是否想听，不考验谁更有资历或值得追随。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If you only tried making a small sheet stand briefly, how would you state that loads and other materials were untested?” Let the listener decide whether to hear it without a contest in seniority or worthiness to lead.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享公开通用说明，也可以不分享。链接不带本次答案或计数，对方可以不回答；不用角色名替朋友下结论。
paragraphs.en: You may share the public general guide or keep it private. Its link carries no attempt answers or counts. The other person may decline; a character name need not become a judgement about a friend.
